LUCIA.bloque: A female chocolate Labrador with a realistic dog head and a human body, gentle amber eyes, wearing a white double-breasted baker jacket with sleeves rolled up, a dark brown canvas apron dusted with flour, and a red bandana tied over her head.
LUCIA.corto: a female chocolate Labrador baker in a white jacket, flour-dusted brown apron and red bandana

TONO.bloque: A young male Beagle with a realistic dog head and a human body, wearing a plain white t-shirt, a cream cotton apron and a white paper baker cap, a small towel over his shoulder.
TONO.corto: a young male Beagle baker's assistant in a white t-shirt, cream apron and paper cap

ALFONSO.bloque: An older male English Bulldog with a realistic dog head and a human body, heavy jowls and a cold stare, wearing a charcoal grey three-piece suit, a white shirt, a navy silk tie, a gold pocket-watch chain across the vest and a gold signet ring.
ALFONSO.corto: an older English Bulldog boss in a charcoal three-piece suit with a gold watch chain

RAQUEL.bloque: A female Dalmatian with a realistic dog head and a human body, wearing a burgundy polo shirt with a small embroidered golden wheat logo, a black name tag and small pearl earrings.
RAQUEL.corto: a female Dalmatian cashier in a burgundy polo shirt

CLIENTE.bloque: An elderly male Basset Hound with a realistic dog head and a human body, long droopy ears, wearing a beige knitted cardigan over a light blue shirt and round wire glasses, holding a paper bag of bread.
CLIENTE.corto: an elderly Basset Hound customer in a beige cardigan and round glasses

NUEVO.bloque: A male Greyhound with a realistic dog head and a human body, wearing a brand-new spotless white baker jacket and a tall white chef hat, looking unsure.
NUEVO.corto: two Greyhound bakers in spotless new white jackets and tall chef hats

lugares.OFICINA: A small luxurious office above a bakery: dark walnut desk with a brass desk lamp, stacks of cash and a ledger, framed old photos of the bakery on the walls, a window looking down onto the busy shop.
lugares.TIENDA: An elegant traditional Mexican bakery shop called "La Espiga Dorada" with the name painted in gold on the window: glass display cases full of conchas and sweet bread, wooden trays and tongs, warm hanging lamps, a long line of dog-headed customers reaching out the door.
lugares.COCINA: The bakery's back kitchen at dawn: large steel ovens glowing orange, flour in the air, wooden worktables with dough, metal racks full of fresh bread trays.
lugares.CALLE: A quiet street corner at sunrise in a Mexican neighborhood: a folding table with a white cloth, a small portable oven, baskets of fresh conchas, a hand-written chalkboard that says "PAN DE LUCÍA", golden morning light.

tomas.frase: Don Alfonso, ya vendemos el triple. Queremos un aumento.
tomas.accion: She stands in front of the desk with her hands together while the boss counts money without looking up.

tomas.frase: Panaderos hay en cada esquina, Lucía.
tomas.accion: He keeps counting bills and barely raises his eyes.

tomas.frase: Pero el pan de nata es receta de ella, jefe.
tomas.accion: He opens his hands toward the Labrador.

tomas.frase: Si no les gusta, ahí está la puerta.
tomas.accion: He points at the door with his pen without standing up.

tomas.frase: Señorita, ¿quién hace este pan? Está buenísimo.
tomas.accion: He takes a bite of a concha at the counter, eyes widening.

tomas.frase: Lucía, nuestra panadera. Lo hace desde las cuatro.
tomas.accion: She hands over a paper bag across the counter.

tomas.frase: Con razón hay fila hasta la calle.
tomas.accion: He turns to look at the long line behind him.

tomas.frase: Masa con paciencia, Toño. Ese es todo el secreto.
tomas.accion: She pulls a tray of golden conchas from the oven.

tomas.frase: Ya se acabó otra charola, jefa.
tomas.accion: He comes in through the swinging door holding an empty tray.

tomas.frase: Don Alfonso, ya no alcanza el pan para la fila.
tomas.accion: She leans in the office doorway.

tomas.frase: Perfecto. Y ya encontré quién lo haga más barato.
tomas.accion: He slides two resumes with prices written on them across the desk.

tomas.frase: ¿Va a cambiar a Lucía? Ella levantó este lugar.
tomas.accion: She steps forward, hand on her chest.

tomas.frase: Lo barato me deja más. Así de simple.
tomas.accion: He leans back in his leather chair and checks his pocket watch.

tomas.frase: Ellos son los nuevos panaderos. Ustedes ya no.
tomas.accion: He points at the two new bakers while the Labrador and the Beagle stand by the oven.

tomas.frase: ¿Después de cinco años nos corre así, Don Alfonso?
tomas.accion: She slowly unties her apron.

tomas.frase: Déjeme la receta en la mesa y váyase.
tomas.accion: He taps the worktable with two fingers.

tomas.frase: La receta se la dejo. Las manos me las llevo.
tomas.accion: She places a worn notebook on the table and turns to leave.

tomas.frase: Don Alfonso, nos están devolviendo el pan.
tomas.accion: She holds up a returned paper bag; the shop is half empty.

tomas.frase: Esto ya no sabe igual. ¿Dónde está la señorita Lucía?
tomas.accion: He puts a half-eaten concha back on the counter.

tomas.frase: Ya no trabaja aquí, señor.
tomas.accion: She lowers her eyes.

tomas.frase: Qué lástima. Yo venía por su pan.
tomas.accion: He puts on his hat and walks toward the door.

tomas.frase: ¡Sigan la receta al pie de la letra!
tomas.accion: He slams the notebook open on the worktable.

tomas.frase: La seguimos, patrón, pero la masa no sube igual.
tomas.accion: He holds up a tray of flat, pale conchas.

tomas.frase: ¿Y la fila? ¿Dónde está la gente?
tomas.accion: He stands alone in the empty shop, full display cases behind him.

tomas.frase: Una mesa y un hornito, jefa. Con eso empezamos.
tomas.accion: He unfolds the table and sets the little oven on it.

tomas.frase: Poquito a poquito, pero con la misma paciencia.
tomas.accion: She arranges fresh conchas in a basket.

tomas.frase: ¡Aquí estaba! Deme diez de nata, señorita.
tomas.accion: He arrives at the stand with a small line forming behind him.

tomas.frase: Y esta vez, todo lo que ganemos es nuestro, Toño.
tomas.accion: She hands a bag to the customer and smiles at the Beagle.
